Description:
This collection includes vintage cigar and cigarette memorabilia featuring wooden cigar boxes from Certified Cremo and Don Carlos with decorative logos, a brown leather-covered cigar box with a gold crest, and a vintage Camel Turkish & Domestic Blend cigarette tin showing wear and patina. Also included is a brown ceramic mug with 'Sip N' Smoke' lettering, a carved wooden tobacco pipe with textured details, a metallic gavel or mallet, and a novelty necktie decorated with colorful cigar band graphics. All items are used and exhibit varying degrees of wear consistent with age. Suitable for collectors of tobacco-related memorabilia and vintage accessories. Some major wear/tear/stains/etc.

284349170.description: This collection features a variety of decorative stones and minerals including polished spheres, crystal points, and carved shapes. Highlights include a red apple-shaped stone, a clear glass orb with bubbles, and a small onyx apple with a golden leaf. The lot also contains polished spheres in multiple colors, crystal tower points in white, blue, and marbled gray, two yellow-green cylindrical mineral specimens, and a large polished agate slice with pink and gray bands. Each piece shows character and charm, with some items displaying original stickers.
